content.short: HIFI is an API for moving money between stablecoins and bank rails, with compliance built in.
content.description: HIFI is infrastructure for moving money across stablecoins and bank rails: one API lets teams accept, convert, route and settle value globally with compliance built in, serving fintechs and large institutions. Stable's official ecosystem page lists HIFI.
